title: AI Roasted My Startup Idea and I Wasn't Ready
description:
What happens when you ask AI to roast your business ideas? 

In this video, I put my entrepreneurial dreams on the line and asked AI to brutally analyze my business concepts. The result? Four bullet points that exposed weaknesses, challenged assumptions, and delivered some harsh truths.

Whether you're a startup founder, entrepreneur, creator, or AI enthusiast, this experiment shows how AI can be used as a powerful brainstorming and validation tool.

Would your business idea survive an AI roast?
